scope: Core mathematical outcomes, stated conditions and quantity labels. This audit does not establish support for every sentence or correctness of every citation.

limits: The 60 negatives are reused regression questions and retain previously documented preflight clarification defects. Safe stopping does not mean every clarification is ideal.
The 24 complex positives are authored development cases, with one response per distinct prompt. A one-case gain is not statistically robust evidence of a general production improvement.
Some completed answers omit adjacent citations for conversions or intermediate operations; no claim of perfect sentence-level grounding is made.
